title: Vision of the Measured City
text:
Ezekiel 40:1-4 In the twenty-fifth year of our captivity, in the beginning of the year, in the tenth day of the month, in the fourteenth year after that the city was struck, in the same day, Yahweh’s hand was on me, and he brought me there.
Ezekiel 40:1-4 In the visions of God he brought me into the land of Israel, and set me down on a very high mountain, on which was something like the frame of a city to the south.
Ezekiel 40:1-4 He brought me there; and, behold, there was a man, whose appearance was like the appearance of bronze, with a line of flax in his hand, and a measuring reed; and he stood in the gate.
Ezekiel 40:1-4 The man said to me, “Son of man, see with your eyes, and hear with your ears, and set your heart on all that I will show you; for you have been brought here so that I may show them to you. Declare all that you see to the house of Israel.”

title: Temple's Measured Throne
text:
Ezekiel 43:1-11 Afterward he brought me to the gate, even the gate that looks toward the east.
Ezekiel 43:1-11 Behold, the glory of the God of Israel came from the way of the east. His voice was like the sound of many waters; and the earth was illuminated with his glory.
Ezekiel 43:1-11 It was according to the appearance of the vision which I saw, even according to the vision that I saw when I came to destroy the city; and the visions were like the vision that I saw by the river Chebar; and I fell on my face.
Ezekiel 43:1-11 Yahweh’s glory came into the house by the way of the gate which faces toward the east.
Ezekiel 43:1-11 The Spirit took me up, and brought me into the inner court; and behold, Yahweh’s glory filled the house.
Ezekiel 43:1-11 I heard one speaking to me out of the house; and a man stood by me.
Ezekiel 43:1-11 He said to me, “Son of man, this is the place of my throne, and the place of the soles of my feet, where I will dwell among the children of Israel forever. The house of Israel will no more defile my holy name, neither they, nor their kings, by their prostitution, and by the dead bodies of their kings in their high places;
Ezekiel 43:1-11 in their setting of their threshold by my threshold, and their door post beside my door post. There was a wall between me and them; and they have defiled my holy name by their abominations which they have committed. Therefore I have consumed them in my anger.
Ezekiel 43:1-11 Now let them put away their prostitution, and the dead bodies of their kings, far from me. Then I will dwell among them forever.
Ezekiel 43:1-11 “You, son of man, show the house to the house of Israel, that they may be ashamed of their iniquities; and let them measure the pattern.
Ezekiel 43:1-11 If they are ashamed of all that they have done, make known to them the form of the house, and its fashion, and its exits, and its entrances, and all its forms, and all its ordinances, and all its forms, and all its laws; and write it in their sight; that they may keep the whole form of it, and all its ordinances, and do them.

title: Prince's Entry Way
text:
Ezekiel 44:1-4 Then he brought me back by the way of the outer gate of the sanctuary, which looks toward the east; and it was shut.
Ezekiel 44:1-4 Yahweh said to me, “This gate shall be shut. It shall not be opened, no man shall enter in by it; for Yahweh, the God of Israel, has entered in by it. Therefore it shall be shut.
Ezekiel 44:1-4 As for the prince, he shall sit in it as prince to eat bread before Yahweh. He shall enter by the way of the porch of the gate, and shall go out the same way.”
Ezekiel 44:1-4 Then he brought me by the way of the north gate before the house; and I looked, and behold, Yahweh’s glory filled Yahweh’s house; so I fell on my face.

title: Sanctuary Ministry Restoration
text:
Ezekiel 44:15-16 “ ‘ “But the Levitical priests, the sons of Zadok, who performed the duty of my sanctuary when the children of Israel went astray from me, shall come near to me to minister to me. They shall stand before me to offer to me the fat and the blood,” says the Lord Yahweh.
Ezekiel 44:15-16 “They shall enter into my sanctuary, and they shall come near to my table, to minister to me, and they shall keep my instruction.

title: Prince's Portion and Tribal Lands
text:
Ezekiel 45:7-8 “ ‘ “What is for the prince shall be on the one side and on the other side of the holy offering and of the possession of the city, in front of the holy offering and in front of the possession of the city, on the west side westward, and on the east side eastward; and in length answerable to one of the portions, from the west border to the east border.
Ezekiel 45:7-8 In the land it shall be to him for a possession in Israel. My princes shall no more oppress my people; but they shall give the land to the house of Israel according to their tribes.”
